concerns.text: FR‑002 (map semantic embeddings into a discrete SymbolicState) is not assigned to any task; no task carries a [FR‑002] tag or implements the embedding‑to‑SymbolicState conversion.
FR‑009 (Sim‑to‑Real Adapter / fine‑tuning protocol for the low‑level controller) is absent; no task references or implements a Sim‑to‑Real adaptation step.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 4 – User Story 1: CPU‑Tractable Symbolic Planner
concerns.text: FR‑011 (detect ambiguous or non‑unique mappings and log `AmbiguousMapping` events) is not covered by any task; T013 and T015 lack any ambiguity‑detection logic.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 3 – Contract Tests for Data Models
concerns.text: FR‑013 (evaluate precision and recall of the embedding‑to‑SymbolicState mapping against a ground‑truth dataset) is missing; no task performs this evaluation or reports the metrics.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 6 – User Story 4: Physics‑Fidelity Isolation Control
concerns.text: FR‑016 (evaluate the Neural Policy using the deterministic Oracle to isolate planning vs. execution effects) is not assigned to any task; the Oracle is used only for the symbolic planner (T037‑T041).

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 7 – User Story 3: Comparative Statistical Analysis
concerns.text: FR‑017 (obtain baseline GPU‑based compute metrics for percentage‑reduction calculations) is not represented by any task; the plan mentions a “GPU escape hatch” but no concrete task collects or stores those metrics.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 5 – User Story 2: Real‑World Execution Validation
concerns.text: FR‑006 (log the specific step where a real‑world failure occurs and label it as Planner Infeasibility or Controller Execution Failure) is not fully satisfied; T024 only adds pose‑deviation checks but does not record step‑wise failure_mode labels as required by the schema.
SC‑012 is referenced in User Story 3 and the plan but never defined in the Success Criteria section, creating an orphan success criterion that cannot be verified.
SC‑007 (total wall‑clock time ≤ 4 hours for all 18 real‑world tasks) lacks a dedicated verification task; no task measures or asserts the aggregate wall‑clock time.

T002 claims to create linting/formatting configuration files, but the analysis report indicates those files are absent; without them the linting verification step cannot succeed, violating the Constitution’s reproducibility and tooling compliance.
